What we do

Jim's Upholstery has been on North Emporia Street since 1978. We reupholster furniture for homeowners, designers and businesses across Wichita and Sedgwick County. Every piece is stripped, repaired and rebuilt in our shop — nothing gets sent out.

Sofa & Couch Reupholstery

Full frame-up rebuild with your fabric or ours. From $650.

Chair & Recliner Reupholstery

Dining chairs, wingbacks, recliners and antiques. From $180.

Cushion & Foam Replacement

New foam, new covers, or both. From $95.

Leather Repair & Restoration

Tears, worn seams, colour matching. From $225.

Questions we get asked

Do you give free estimates?

Yes. Send photos or bring the piece in and we'll give you a firm price, not a range.

Do you pick up and deliver?

Yes, throughout Wichita and the surrounding towns. There's a small charge outside Sedgwick County.

Can I supply my own fabric?

Absolutely. Plenty of customers do. We'll tell you how many yards you need before you buy.

How long does a job take?

Seat-only work is a few days. Chairs are one to two weeks. Sofas are two to three, mostly waiting on fabric.
